entries.title: Proverbs 4:3
segments:
My father's son; in an emphatic sense, a son tenderly beloved and cherished. 
 
  Only beloved; loved like an only son, that is, very tenderly; for Solomon was not literally the only son of his mother. See 1Ch 3.5.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:4
segments:
He taught me also; Solomon commends his instructions to the young as those which he had received from his father in childhood, and obedience to which had made him prosperous and honored. 
 
They who, by precept and example, teach their children to value heavenly wisdom above all earthly possessions, may hope to see them made by God's grace useful and honorable, and the instructors of the following generation.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:7
segments: With all thy getting get understanding; either, Among all thy other acquisitions be sure to get wisdom first; or better thus: Employ all thy worldly gain to get wisdom: part with it all, if need be, for her sake.

That men so universally prefer wealth to wisdom, shows the blindness of the natural heart; but they whom God's Spirit has enlightened, understand well that the knowledge of the truth is better than all riches.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:12
segments: Shall not be straitened; thou shalt have a wide and plain path in which thou canst go safely.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:15
segments: Avoid it--pass away; the accumulation of admonitions shows the extreme danger of the way.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:16
segments: Sin has a dreadful power to perpetuate itself.  They who enter upon a course of transgression proceed from bad to worse, till their life becomes one continuous series of sins.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:18
segments:
The shining light; of the morning sun. 
 
  Perfect day; noon.  Light is here the emblem of knowledge, holiness, and happiness. 
 
How glorious is the just man's course.  In this life he is increasing in knowledge, holiness, and usefulness; and he has before him an eternity of light and bliss.  "The ungodly are not so."  They walk in darkness and self-delusion, and stumble unawares into perdition.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:19
segments: Know not at what they stumble; they cannot see the stumbling-blocks that lie in their way, and they fall over them unawares.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:23
segments:
Issues; fountains: when the heart is well kept, and stored with heavenly wisdom, it sends forth life-giving streams. 
 
If men bestowed upon their hearts that care which they give to their estates, they would be rewarded with peace and prosperity, instead of disappointment and consuming anxiety.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:25
segments:
Right on--straight before thee; as one looks who is intent upon pursuing a straight path, the path of God's commandments. 
 
Straightforward integrity lies at the foundation of all true excellence and permanent success.  When men rely on crooked artifices, they and their plans will in the end be carried headlong.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:26
segments: They who earnestly and prayerfully ponder their path, shall be guided in the right way; but inconsiderateness always ends in shame and misery.
